scope: 16 newly recognized components (12 Abilities, 4 Trainers) and 14 fully supported additional cards; no previous supported program or metadata changes.

sources.title: Official advanced rules D-14
sources.checkedFacts: Full HP means zero damage counters. Sturdy is a survival replacement; Spiteful Magic requires an actual attack-damage Knock Out.

sources.title: Pikachu ex Resolute Heart
sources.checkedFacts: Full-HP host survives a lethal attack with 10 HP; the text is not restricted to opposing attacks or the Active Spot.

sources.title: Survival Brace
sources.checkedFacts: Full-HP survival only against opposing attack damage; discard the attached Tool after using its effect.

sources.title: Focus Sash official rulings
sources.checkedFacts: The host owner can order Sturdy and Focus Sash. Effects that ignore damage modifiers do not cancel this KO replacement; source suppression is a separate matter.

sources.title: Crustle official counter-placement ruling
sources.checkedFacts: Moving damage counters onto Crustle does not constitute attack damage and cannot trigger Sturdy.

sources.title: Mismagius Spiteful Magic
sources.checkedFacts: A full-HP Pokemon actually Knocked Out by opposing attack damage places eight counters on the captured attacker.

sources.title: Box of Disaster
sources.checkedFacts: The full-HP actual-KO reaction applies only to an attached Pokemon V and places eight counters on the attacking Pokemon.

boundaries: 14 additional complete cards; 16 components; no old supported program or metadata changes.
Pre-damage full HP is event data, never a current damage-count condition after the hit.
Lethal damage survival is separate from an actual KO reaction; surviving never grants the KO reflection.
Repeated damage after healing cannot inherit an earlier lethal hit's full-HP state.
Only a survival Tool actually used is discarded; the owner orders competing replacements.
Source suppression, direct KO and Checkup stay distinct from attack damage.
